title: Kenyan Pilaf with Yellow Morbier
description: A flavorful Kenyan-inspired dish featuring yellow morbier and pilaf. This recipe is perfect for a dinner meal.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the Kenyan spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced yellow morbier and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the cooked pilaf and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
